title: arabic-digital-humanities/root-extraction-validation-data: 0.1.0
description:
Dataset for evaluating root extraction

This dataset contains data to evaluate the roots extracted by Arabic stemmers and morphological analyzers.

The dataset was created in the context of the Bridging the Gap project.

The txt directory contains the text files for which roots were extracted, and gs contains csv files with columns word and root, containing the words from the text and the manually corrected roots. If multiple roots apply, they have been separated using a backslash (\). If the word is a letter, the root is #.

The text files have been analyzed using SAFAR, using our software. The directories khoja, isri, and alkhalil contain the output xml files.
